description: This file implements the server-side logic for displaying a list view in the vtiger CRM application, including session management, data querying, sorting, and rendering via Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty wrapper class for vtiger CRM templates.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations and permissions for modules.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Generates SQL queries for list views based on user search conditions and view settings.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Manages the retrieval of list view headers and entries, as well as search options.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes the sorting field for the list view.

methods.name: hasViewChanged
methods.description: Checks if the current view has changed and resets sort order if necessary.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the field by which the list view is sorted.

methods.name: IsCustomModule
methods.description: Indicates whether the current module is a custom module.

methods.name: getUserslist
methods.description: Provides a list of users for owner transfer features.

methods.name: getGroupslist
methods.description: Provides a list of groups for owner transfer features.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the current custom view for the module.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML select element for custom views.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Retrieves details of a custom view by its ID.

methods.name: isPermittedChangeStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the user can change the status of a custom view.

methods.name: isPermittedCustomView
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for editing or deleting custom views.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query for data retrieval based on current filters, searches, and sorting.

methods.name: getConditionalWhere
methods.description: Provides the WHERE clause conditions for filtering.

methods.name: addUserSearchConditions
methods.description: Adds user-defined search conditions to the query generator.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates the headers for the list view table.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the data entries to be displayed in the list view.
